title: ReFrame – The EPaper Camera
summary: ReFrame is an innovative camera project that utilizes e-paper display technology to create a unique photography device with minimalist design and ultra-low power consumption. The camera likely captures images and displays them on an e-ink screen, offering a distinct analog-like digital photography experience.
problem_solved: Provides a sustainable, low-power alternative to traditional digital cameras for minimalist photography enthusiasts.
why_valuable: Combines the instant gratification of digital photography with the aesthetic of physical paper prints, while dramatically reducing power consumption for extended battery life.
